Barnaby glanced up at the spiral stairs spiraling into dusk, then out toward the blackening water, where three pale masts cut silently through the swell without a single lantern of their own.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市尚未醒转，整座喧嚣的钢铁丛林浸泡在幽蓝的寒雾中。主干道空旷得令人心慌，唯有偶尔呼啸而过的洒水车与环卫工单薄的橘色背影打破静寂。路灯拉长了斑驳的树影，二十四小时便利店透出孤岛般温暖的白光。高楼只剩零星几扇未眠的窗，沉默地守望着黑夜与白昼的交割。", "w03": "- Recursion is like facing two mirrors toward each other and seeing yourself inside yourself over and over.\n- In coding, it means a task solves itself by calling a smaller copy of the exact same task.\n- It always needs a stop rule, like finishing the last doll inside a nested Russian matryoshka."}
